summary: GeoVax Labs, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement of pre-funded warrants and common warrants, raising net proceeds of approximately $2.7 million at an offering price of $1.4799 per unit. The securities are unregistered, issued under Rule 506 of Regulation D. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as placement agent. This capital-raising transaction does not constitute a special situation as defined—it is a routine equity financing, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing's terms lack special-situation triggers such as premiums, break fees, or board recommendations typical of M&A or shareholder-altering events.
